WIND.description: Wind Load (WIND). The WIND_CODE value selects which single code sub-object is required and consumed (e.g. KS1992 -> KS92, ASCE7(2016) -> ASCE7_16); all other code sub-objects are ignored for that entry.

RC.description: Roughness category (case-insensitive; token as declared in C++).

SITE.description: Site category (case-insensitive; token as declared in C++).

topoItem.description: One topography (hill) definition. Used as array items for IBC2009/IBC2012/NSR-10/ASCE7 (X-dir then Y-dir).

bTOPOGRAPHY.description: Include topographic effect for this direction.

IBC0912.description: IBC 2009 / IBC 2012 (ASCE7-05/-10) parameters. IMPORTANCE_FACTOR only for IBC2009. CNET_* apply when PROCEDURE==1; direction/roof/rigidity/gust/topography/force fields apply when PROCEDURE!=1.

ASCE7.description: ASCE7(2016)/ASCE7(2022)/NSCP 2024 parameters. TOPOGRAPHY_ITEMS holds two entries (X then Y direction).

KDS2021_GENERAL.description: KDS 2021 general-method parameters. VORTEX_* apply when bVORTEX_SHEDDING=true; the remaining fields apply when bVORTEX_SHEDDING=false.

profileComp.description: Read-only computed profile component (one story row).

WIND_CODE.description: Wind load code name (case-insensitive). Drives which code sub-object below is required. Mapping: KS1992->KS92, JP1987->JP87, UBC1997->UBC97, ANSI1982->ANSI82, KS2000->KS2000, IBC2000->IBC2000, EURO1992->EURO1992, BS6399(97)->BS6399_1997, CH2001->CH2002, JP2000->JPN2000, NBC1995->NBC1995, IS875(87)->IS1987, TWN2002->TAIWAN1986, JP2004->JP2004, EURO2005->EURO2005, KBC(2009)->KBC2009, IBC2009->IBC2009, IBC2012->IBC2012, CH2012->CH2012, NSR-10->NSR2010, KBC(2016)/KDS(41-10-15:2019)->KDS19_KBC16, KDS(41-12:2022)->KDS2021, IS875(2015)->IS875_2015, CH2021->CH2019, DPT.1311-50:2007->DPT2007, ASCE7(2016)->ASCE7_16, ASCE7(2022)->ASCE7_22, NSCP 2024->NSCP2024, SI2023->SI2023, USER TYPE->USER.

IBC2000.description: [WIND_CODE=IBC2000] IBC 2000 parameters. Optional fields apply only when PROCEDURE!=1; the hill fields additionally require bTOPOGRAPHY=true.

CH2002.description: [WIND_CODE=CH2001] China 2001/2002 parameters. STRUCTURAL_MATL/DAMPING_RATIO/PERIOD_* apply when PULSE_MAGNIFY_METHOD==0; PULSE_MAGNIFY_FACTOR_* apply when PULSE_MAGNIFY_METHOD==1.

PULSE_MAGNIFY_METHOD.description: Pulse magnify method (0: automatic calculation, 1: user defined).

NBC1995.description: [WIND_CODE=NBC1995] NBC 1995 parameters. GUST_FACTOR applies when PROCEDURE==1; GUST_FACTOR_*/EXP_CATEGORY apply when PROCEDURE!=1; hill fields require bTOPOGRAPHY=true.

IS1987.description: [WIND_CODE=IS875(87)] IS 875 (1987) parameters. BLDG_CLASS/FRICTION_COEF apply when PROCEDURE==1; GUST_FACTOR/force fields when PROCEDURE==2; STRUCTURE_CLASS when bAUTO_CALC_RISK=true, RISK_COEF otherwise; topography fields require bTOPOGRAPHY=true.

JP2004.description: [WIND_CODE=JP2004] Japan 2004 parameters. ENV_FACTOR/force fields apply when PROCEDURE==1; MEAN_WIND_SPEED/EXP_CATEGORY/direction & dynamic fields apply when PROCEDURE!=1; hill X/Y fields require the matching bTOPOGRAPHY_X/Y=true.

EURO2005.description: [WIND_CODE=EURO2005] Eurocode 2005 parameters. FORCE_COEF applies when bUSE_FORCE_COEF=true; CPE/LACK fields when bUSE_FORCE_COEF=false (CPE_* also require CPE_METHOD!=0, LACK_FACTOR requires LACK_METHOD!=0); ORO_*/NEI_*/DIS_* require bOROGRAPHY/bNEIGHBOR/bDISPLACE=true.

NSR2010.description: [WIND_CODE=NSR-10] NSR-10 parameters. TOPOGRAPHY_ITEMS holds two entries (X-dir then Y-dir).

KDS19_KBC16.description: [WIND_CODE=KBC(2016) or KDS(41-10-15:2019)] Input method selector. INPUT_METHOD==0 uses SIMPLE; otherwise uses GENERAL.

KDS2021.description: [WIND_CODE=KDS(41-12:2022)] Input method selector. INPUT_METHOD==0 uses SIMPLE; otherwise uses GENERAL.

IS875_2015.description: [WIND_CODE=IS875(2015)] IS 875 (2015) parameters. STRUCTURE_CLASS when bAUTO_CALC_RISK_COEF=true else RISK_COEF; topography fields require bTOPOGRAPHY=true; BLDG_CLASS/cyclonic fields for PROCEDURE 1 or 2; FRICTION_COEF/force fields for PROCEDURE==1; GUST_PARAMS for PROCEDURE==2.

PROFILE.description: Read-only computed wind profile results (returned on GET; ignored on write).
